title: cydonia delavayi
intro: Cydonia delavayi, commonly known as Chinese quince, is a deciduous shrub native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cydonia delavayi include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Cydonia delavayi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
